name: ai-talk
description: AI Talk gates every user message in development conversations, releasing status and confirmation messages unchanged, compiling clear development work into executable RequirementContract 1.2 handoffs, and holding only implementation-changing blockers.

interface.shortDescription: Gate every message in development conversations
interface.longDescription: AI Talk is the single preflight gate for every user message in a development conversation and requires no command prefix. Non-development conversations do not invoke it. Status questions, confirmations, and updates that need no contract revision are released unchanged. Clear development work is compiled into RequirementContract 1.2 and released directly or after bounded evidence enrichment. Only blockers that change the product result or writable scope are held for one decisive question. Each message is evaluated once, so downstream Skills never loop back through AI Talk.
capabilities: Transparent pass-through for status and confirmation messages
Stable selector and DOM fingerprint capture
Entry point and control point separation
Live browser evidence for UI failures
DOM, geometry, occlusion, and resource inspection
